ငါးရက ညီညီမျှမျှယူကြမည်။
အရသာကို လျှာက သိသည်။
မျှမျှတတ သဘောထားပါ။
လယ်ထဲမှာ ရေလျှံနေပြီ။
လျှောကျမည် သတိထား။
ကလေးကို မြှူနေသည်။
အာဟာရ မျှပါစေ။
There are leeches in the pond.
We will fish.
Bring a fishing rod.
We will share the fish equally.
The tongue knows the taste.
The seller is waiting.
Will they give a discount?
Be fair and impartial.
The field is flooded.
Rafts (of straw) are floating.
Float a boat and retrieve them.
Beware of slipping.
He is trying to coax the child.
Coaxing is not working.
Is there a sore on his tongue?
Let the nutrition be balanced.
အရသာကို ဘာက သိသလဲ။  --- လျှာ
ဘယ်သူက လမ်းကနေ မျှော်နေသလဲ။  --- ဈေးသည်
ကလေးကို ဘာလုပ်သော်လည်း မရဖြစ်နေသလဲ။  --- ချော့မြူသော်လည်း မရပါ။
ငါးရတဲ့အခါ ဘယ်လို ခွဲယူကြမလဲ။  --- ညီညီမျှမျှ ယူကြပါမည်။
စိတ်ကို ဘယ်လို သဘောထားရမလဲ။  --- မျှမျှတတ သဘောထားရပါ။
ဘယ်လိုအခါ/ဘယ်အချိန်မှာ သတိထားရမလဲ။  --- လျှောကျမည့် သတိထား
What is in the pond? --- Leech.
What senses taste? --- The tongue.
What are floating in the water? --- Bundles of fiber strings.
What is on the tongue? --- A sore.
What is said to be balanced? --- May the nutrition be balanced.
Who is watching from the road? --- The vendor.
Who is being coaxed? --- The child.
What should be brought for fishing? --- A fishing rod.
What is not working no matter what is done to the child? --- Even though coaxed, it doesn't work.
Where is the water overflowing? --- Water is overflowing in the field.
How will the fish be divided when caught? --- We will share equally.
How should you keep your mind? --- Keep a fair and just mindset.
How will you ask the vendor? --- Will you lower the price?
How should the bundles of fiber be retrieved? --- Retrieve them by floating a boat.
When should you be careful? --- Watch out for slipping.
When should you be careful? --- Be careful of slipping down.
